ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 22
   C. 38
   D. 88

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 30
   C. 46
   D. 23

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

6. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 11

7. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 20

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

9. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 48

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

11. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 100

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

14. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

17. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 7

18. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

19. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 19
   D. 23

20. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

21. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

22. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

23. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

24. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

25. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 3

26. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

27. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

28. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 6

29. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 65
   C. 64
   D. 0

30. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12
